t: DEWALT MaxFit mixed demolition screwdriver 6-piece set offers robust performance for various fastening tasks. Features an advanced MaxFit tip design, engineered to deliver optimal contact with fasteners to minimise instances of slippage and stripping. Each demolition screwdriver is constructed with a durable S2 steel bar, for enhanced durability and resistance to bending under load. The ergonomic, bi-material handle is designed for maximum user comfort and allows for increased torque, enabling efficient operation with reduced fatigue.
b: Contents: Flared (5.5 x 125, 6.5 x 150 and 8 x 150), PH1 x 100, PH2 x 125 and PH3 x 125mm.
Black Chrome for Better Rust & Corrosion Resistance
